title: Gradient TD($\lambda$) for Non-Linear Function Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal difference (TD) learning is central to reinforcement learning. Many methods use semi-gradient TD, which may diverge, or develop algorithms with mean-squared Bellman or TD-error objectives that are difficult to analyze. Gradient TD algorithms overcome these challenges by using projection of the value function and present convergent off-policy algorithms. However, the algorithm for $\lambda$-return was limited to linear function approximation. Here, we extend the same to non-linear function approximation, which is desirable since many strong modern function approximators are complex and non-linear. Recent works have derived similar algorithms with a generalized projected Bellman error objective. Alternatively, we continue working with the projected Bellman error.

translated_title: 用于非线性函数逼近的梯度TD(λ)
translated_abstract: 时序差分（TD）学习是强化学习的核心。许多方法使用半梯度TD，这可能会导致发散；或者发展出基于均方贝尔曼误差或TD误差目标的算法，而这些目标难以分析。梯度TD算法通过使用价值函数的投影克服了这些挑战，并提出了收敛的离策略算法。然而，针对λ回报的算法此前仅限于线性函数逼近。在本文中，我们将其扩展到非线性函数逼近，这是非常理想的，因为许多强大的现代函数逼近器都是复杂且非线性的。最近的工作已经通过广义投影贝尔曼误差目标推导出了类似的算法。与之不同，我们继续使用（标准的）投影贝尔曼误差。
tldr: 本文将梯度TD(λ)算法从线性函数逼近扩展到非线性函数逼近，并继续采用投影贝尔曼误差目标，为现代复杂非线性函数逼近器提供了具有收敛保证的离策略学习算法。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Gradient TD(λ) from linear to non-linear function approximation while continuing to use the projected Bellman error, providing convergent off-policy algorithms for modern complex non-linear function approximators.
